title: BET bromodomain inhibitors.
one_liner_zh: 综述BET溴结构域抑制剂开发，聚焦表观遗传阅读器与乙酰化修饰，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Lysine acetylation creates docking sites for epigenetic reader domains of BET bromodomain proteins that have emerged as principal regulators of linage specific gene transcription. The development of potent and highly selective inhibitors, that have been soon widely available, enabled mechanistic studies in a diversity of disease models leading to a rapid translation into the clinic. Initial studies on pan-BET inhibitors lead now to second generation inhibitors with improved domain selectivity, but also to highly potent bifunctional and dual inhibitors extending the toolbox for basic research on acetylation dependent transcription, BET associated diseases and further translational efforts targeting this interesting family of epigenetic reader domains.
abstract_zh: 赖氨酸乙酰化为BET溴结构域蛋白的表观遗传阅读器结构域创建了对接位点，这些蛋白已成为谱系特异性基因转录的主要调控因子。高效且高度选择性的抑制剂迅速广泛可用，促进了多种疾病模型中的机制研究，并迅速转化为临床应用。针对泛BET抑制剂的初步研究现已催生出具有改进结构域选择性的第二代抑制剂，同时也产生了高效的双功能及双重抑制剂，扩展了乙酰化依赖性转录、BET相关疾病基础研究以及针对这一有趣表观遗传阅读器结构域家族的进一步转化研究的工具箱。
